Response Text:---
The `placePipe` method should convert the given row and column into a `Coordinate` object, then attempt to place the current pipe from the `pipeQueue` onto the map at that coordinate. If placement succeeds, it should update the `pipeQueue` by removing the placed pipe, update the `delayBar`, push the placed cell onto the `cellStack` for undo support, and increment the number of steps.

Here is a complete implementation of the `placePipe` method:

```java
public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
    // Convert column character to 1-based column index (assuming 'A' or 'a' corresponds to 1)
    int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);

    // Get the current pipe to place
    Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    if (currentPipe == null) {
        return false; // No pipe to place
    }

    // Try to place the pipe on the map
    boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
    if (!placed) {
        return false;
    }

    // Update pipe queue by removing the placed pipe
    pipeQueue.poll();

    // Update delay bar
    delayBar.addDelay();

    // Push the placed cell onto the cell stack for undo
    Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
    if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
    }

    // Increment the number of steps
    numOfSteps++;

    return true;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Converts the column character to an integer index (1-based).
- Creates a `Coordinate` with the given row and calculated column.
- Retrieves the current pipe from the `pipeQueue`.
- Attempts to place the pipe on the map at the coordinate.
- If successful, removes the pipe from the queue, updates the delay bar, pushes the placed cell onto the stack, and increments the step count.
- Returns `true` if the pipe was placed successfully, otherwise `false`.

public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
    // Convert column character to 1-based column index (assuming 'A' or 'a' corresponds to 1)
    int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);

    // Get the current pipe to place
    Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    if (currentPipe == null) {
        return false; // No pipe to place
    }

    // Try to place the pipe on the map
    boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
    if (!placed) {
        return false;
    }

        cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
    }

    // Increment the number of steps
    numOfSteps++;

    return true;

```java
	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}
```

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
```java
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.addDelay();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
```

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.addDelay();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
```java
	}
```

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = lastCell.getCoordinate();
		map.resetCell(coord);
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.addDelay();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.addDelay();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}
```

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = lastCell.getCoordinate();
		map.resetCell(coord);
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
```java
	}
```

	public void updateState() {
		int distance = delayBar.getDelay();
		if (distance > 0) {
			map.fillTiles(distance);
			delayBar.reset();
		}
	}

	/**
```java
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
```
```java
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}
```

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
```java
	}
```
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.addDelay();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.addDelay();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = lastCell.getCoordinate();
		map.resetCell(coord);
```

Response Text:---
The errors occur because the constructors `Game(int, int)` and `Game(int, int, int, Cell[][], List<Pipe>)` are declared as methods (with a return type `void`) instead of proper constructors. In Java, constructors must not have a return type.

To fix this, remove the `void` return type from these methods so they become proper constructors.

Here is the corrected `Game` class with the constructors fixed:

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Fixed constructor: removed 'void'
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Fixed constructor: removed 'void'
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.addDelay();
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            delayBar.addDelay();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        Coordinate coord = lastCell.getCoordinate();
        map.resetCell(coord);
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getDelay();
        if (distance > 0) {
            map.fillTiles(distance);
            delayBar.reset();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**  
Constructors in Java must not have a return type, not even `void`. Declaring them with a return type makes them regular methods, so the compiler does not recognize them as constructors, causing the "constructor undefined" errors. Removing `void` fixes the issue.

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.addDelay();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.addDelay();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		Coordinate coord = lastCell.getCoordinate();
		map.resetCell(coord);
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int distance = delayBar.getDelay();
		if (distance > 0) {
			map.fillTiles(distance);
			delayBar.reset();
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
	}
}
```

package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Fixed constructor: removed 'void'
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Fixed constructor: removed 'void'
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.addDelay();
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            delayBar.addDelay();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        Coordinate coord = lastCell.getCoordinate();
        map.resetCell(coord);
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getDelay();
        if (distance > 0) {
            map.fillTiles(distance);
            delayBar.reset();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
    }
}

**Explanation:**  
Constructors in Java must not have a return type, not even `void`. The original code had `public void Game(...)` which is a method, not a constructor, so the compiler did not recognize it as a constructor, causing the "constructor undefined" errors.     @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Correct constructor (no void)
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Correct constructor (no void)
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = (pipes == null) ? new PipeQueue() : new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.addDelay();
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            delayBar.addDelay();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        Coordinate coord = lastCell.getCoordinate();
        map.resetCell(coord);
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getDelay();
        if (distance > 0) {
            map.fillTiles(distance);
            delayBar.reset();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost() || (pipeQueue.isEmpty() && !hasWon());
    }

	 */

	}

```java
	void push(final FillableCell cell) {
		cellStack.push(cell);
	}
```

```java
	FillableCell pop() {
```
```java
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {

		count++;
```

```java
package game;
```

```java
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
```java
	}
```

	void consume() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes to consume.");
		}
		pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

```java
	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
	}
```
}

```java
package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}

	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
	}

	void consume() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes to consume.");
		}
		pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
```java
	}
```
```java
}
```

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Fill edges with walls and inner cells with empty fillable cells
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
            } else {
                cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
            }
        }
    }

    // Generate source cell info (non-edge cell, direction not pointing into wall)
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
    Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;

    // Place source cell
    sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
    cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;

    // Generate sink cell info (edge cell, direction pointing outside map)
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
    do {
        sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
        // Ensure sink cell is not the same as source cell
    } while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
    Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
    Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;

    // Place sink cell
    sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
    cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
```
```java
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}
```

The constructor `Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells)` should initialize the map dimensions and cells, then validate and assign the source and sink tiles according to the rules:

- Exactly one source tile in a non-edge cell.
- Exactly one sink tile in an edge cell.
- The source tile must not point into a wall.
- The sink tile must point outside the map.

Here is a complete implementation of the constructor that performs these steps:

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
    }
    if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
    }
    for (Cell[] row : cells) {
        if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
        }
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    TerminationCell foundSource = null;
    TerminationCell foundSink = null;

    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = cells[r][c];
            if (cell == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
            }
            this.cells[r][c] = cell;

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
                Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
                boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
                if (tc.isSource()) {
                    // Source must be in non-edge cell
                    if (isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell cannot be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    if (foundSource != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
                    }
                    // Source direction must not point into a wall
                    Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    if (!isValidCoordinate(adjacent) || this.cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col] instanceof Wall) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    foundSource = tc;
                } else {
                    // Sink must be on edge
                    if (!isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    // Sink direction must point outside the map
                    Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    if (isValidCoordinate(adjacent)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    if (foundSink != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
                    }
                    foundSink = tc;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (foundSource == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
    }
    if (foundSink == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
    }

    this.sourceCell = foundSource;
    this.sinkCell = foundSink;
}

private boolean isValidCoordinate(Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Validates input dimensions and cells array shape.
- Copies the cells into the internal array.
- Scans all cells to find exactly one source and one sink.
- Checks source is inside (not on edge), sink is on edge.
- Checks source direction points to a non-wall cell inside the map.
- Checks sink direction points outside the map.

public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
    }
    if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
    }
    for (Cell[] row : cells) {
        if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
        }
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    TerminationCell foundSource = null;
    TerminationCell foundSink = null;

    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = cells[r][c];
            if (cell == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
            }
            this.cells[r][c] = cell;

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
                Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
                boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
                if (tc.isSource()) {
                    // Source must be in non-edge cell
                    if (isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell cannot be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    if (foundSource != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
                    }
                    // Source direction must not point into a wall
                    Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    if (!isValidCoordinate(adjacent) || this.cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col] instanceof Wall) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    foundSource = tc;
                } else {
                    // Sink must be on edge
                    if (!isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    // Sink direction must point outside the map
                    Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
                    if (isValidCoordinate(adjacent)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
                    }
                    if (foundSink != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
                    }
                    foundSink = tc;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (foundSource == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
    }
    if (foundSink == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
    }

    this.sourceCell = foundSource;
    this.sinkCell = foundSink;
}

private boolean isValidCoordinate(Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
```

Here is a complete implementation of the method:

```java
boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
    // Convert one-based to zero-based indices
    int r = row - 1;
    int c = col - 1;

    // Check bounds
    if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
        return false;
    }

    Cell cell = cells[r][c];

    // Check if cell is a FillableCell and not already occupied
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
            fillableCell.setPipe(p);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

This implementation assumes that `FillableCell` has methods `getPipe()` and `setPipe(Pipe)` to get and set the pipe in the cell. It respects the one-based indexing as specified in the method parameters.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {

			}

			System.out.println();
		}

	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adjacent) || this.cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}
}
```

```java
	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adjacent) || this.cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[r][c];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The method `fillTiles(int distance)` should fill all fillable cells (pipes) within the given Manhattan distance from the `sourceCell`. A good approach is to perform a breadth-first search (BFS) starting from the `sourceCell` coordinate, expanding outward up to the given distance, and marking fillable cells as filled.

Here is a complete implementation of `fillTiles` using BFS:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
        return;
    }

    // Clear previously filled tiles
    filledTiles.clear();

    // Queue for BFS: stores pairs of (Coordinate, currentDistance)
    Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
    queue.add(Map.entry(start, 0));
    filledTiles.add(start);

    // Mark the source cell as filled
    sourceCell.setFilled();

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer> entry = queue.poll();
        Coordinate coord = entry.getKey();
        int dist = entry.getValue();

        if (dist >= distance) {
            continue;
        }

        // Explore neighbors in four directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = coord.add(dir.getOffset());

            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell cell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
            if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
                // Fill the cell and add to queue
                fillableCell.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                queue.add(Map.entry(neighbor, dist + 1));
            } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
                // Also fill termination cells if within distance
                terminationCell.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                queue.add(Map.entry(neighbor, dist + 1));
            }
            // Walls or other cells are not filled or traversed
        }
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**

- We start BFS from the `sourceCell` coordinate with distance 0.
- For each cell dequeued, if its distance is less than the target `distance`, we enqueue its adjacent fillable or termination cells with distance + 1.
- We mark each visited cell as filled by calling `setFilled()`.
- We keep track of filled tiles in the `filledTiles` set to avoid revisiting.
- Walls and other non-fillable cells are skipped.
- This ensures all fillable cells within the given distance from the source are filled.

This method respects the hint and uses an iterative BFS approach to fill pipes by distance.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adjacent) || this.cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall or outside map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[r][c];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		if (!isValidCoordinate(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of map bounds: " + coord);
		}
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not a FillableCell");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `checkPath` method should determine if there is a valid path from the `sourceCell` to the `sinkCell` through connected pipes and cells. A Breadth-First Search (BFS) is appropriate here: starting from the source cell, explore all reachable neighboring cells that are connected properly by pipes until the sink cell is found or no more cells can be visited.

The key points:
- Start BFS from the source cell coordinate.
- For each cell, check all directions where the pipe connects.
- Only move to adjacent cells if the pipes connect correctly (i.e., the current cell's pipe connects to the neighbor cell's pipe in the opposite direction).
- If the sink cell is reached, return true.
- If BFS ends without reaching the sink, return false.

Here is a complete implementation of `checkPath()`:

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.add(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
            continue;
        }

        Pipe currentPipe = null;
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // TerminationCell is considered connected in the direction it points
            currentPipe = null; // no pipe, but we treat it as connected in its direction
        }

        // For TerminationCell, consider the direction it points as the only connection
        List<Direction> directionsToCheck = new ArrayList<>();
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            directionsToCheck.add(terminationCell.getDirection());
        } else if (currentPipe != null) {
            directionsToCheck.addAll(currentPipe.getConnectedDirections());
        } else {
            // No pipe and not a termination cell with direction, no connections
            continue;
        }

        for (Direction dir : directionsToCheck) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighborCoord) || visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (!(neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Check if neighbor cell has a pipe or is termination cell and connects back
            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
                neighborPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTermination) {
                // For sink cell, check if its direction is opposite to current direction
                if (!neighborTermination.getDirection().equals(dir.getOpposite())) {
                    continue;
                }
                // Sink cell reached, add to queue
            }

            // Check if neighbor pipe connects back in the opposite direction
            if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.getConnectedDirections().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
                continue;
            }

            // Valid connection, add neighbor to queue
            visited.add(neighborCoord);
            queue.add(neighborCoord);
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- We start BFS from the source cell coordinate.
- For each cell, we get the directions in which the pipe connects.
- For each direction, we check the neighbor cell:
  - It must be inside the map and not visited.
  - It must be a FillableCell with a pipe or a TerminationCell.
  - The neighbor's pipe must connect back in the opposite direction.
  - For TerminationCell, the direction must be opposite to the current direction.
- If the sink cell coordinate is reached, return true.
- If BFS finishes without reaching sink, return false.

This method assumes that `Pipe` has a method `getConnectedDirections()` returning a collection of `Direction` where the pipe connects, and that `Coordinate` has an `add(Direction.Offset)` method returning a new coordinate offset by the direction. These are consistent with the provided code context.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {

			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell cannot be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (!isValidCoordinate(adjacent) || this.cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col] instanceof Wall) {

						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(tc.getDirection().getOffset());
						if (isValidCoordinate(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[r][c];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		if (!isValidCoordinate(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of map bounds: " + coord);
		}
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not a FillableCell");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.coord;
		queue.add(Map.entry(start, 0));
		filledTiles.add(start);
		sourceCell.setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer> entry = queue.poll();
			Coordinate coord = entry.getKey();
			int dist = entry.getValue();
			if (dist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				if (filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell cell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
					fillableCell.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(neighbor);
					queue.add(Map.entry(neighbor, dist + 1));
				} else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
					terminationCell.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(neighbor);
					queue.add(Map.entry(neighbor, dist + 1));
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.add(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
            continue;
        }

        Pipe currentPipe = null;
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // TerminationCell is considered connected in the direction it points
            currentPipe = null; // no pipe, but we treat it as connected in its direction
        }

        // For TerminationCell, consider the direction it points as the only connection
        List<Direction> directionsToCheck = new ArrayList<>();
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            directionsToCheck.add(terminationCell.getDirection());
        } else if (currentPipe != null) {
            directionsToCheck.addAll(currentPipe.getConnectedDirections());
        } else {
            // No pipe and not a termination cell with direction, no connections
            continue;
        }

        for (Direction dir : directionsToCheck) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighborCoord) || visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (!(neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Check if neighbor cell has a pipe or is termination cell and connects back
            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
                neighborPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue;
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTermination) {
                // For sink cell, check if its direction is opposite to current direction
                if (!neighborTermination.getDirection().equals(dir.getOpposite())) {
                    continue;
                }
                // Sink cell reached, add to queue
            }

            // Check if neighbor pipe connects back in the opposite direction
            if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.getConnectedDirections().contains(dir.getOpposite())) {
                continue;
            }

            // Valid connection, add neighbor to queue
            visited.add(neighborCoord);
            queue.add(neighborCoord);
        }
    }

    return false;

The method `hasLost` should return `true` if no new pipes were filled during the current round. The class `Map` tracks filled tiles in the `filledTiles` set and the number of previously filled tiles in `prevFilledTiles`. If after a round the size of `filledTiles` is the same as `prevFilledTiles`, it means no new pipes were filled, so the game is lost.

A correct implementation would compare the current number of filled tiles to the previous count, return `true` if they are equal (no new pipes filled), and update `prevFilledTiles` for the next round.

Here is a complete implementation of the `hasLost` method:

```java
/**
 * <p>
 * Hint: The game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round. Is
 * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?
 * </p>
 *
 * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.
 */
public boolean hasLost() {
    boolean lost = filledTiles.size() == prevFilledTiles;
    prevFilledTiles = filledTiles.size();
    return lost;
}
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {

			}

		}

	}
```
