 *
 * @see <a href='https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knight_(chess)'>Wikipedia</a>
 */
public class Knight extends Piece {
	public Knight(Player player) {
		super(player);
	}

	@Override
	public char getLabel() {
		return 'K';
	}

	 * Returns an array of moves that are valid given the current place of the piece.

	 *
	 * @param game   the game object
	 * @param source the current place of the piece
	 * @return an array of available moves
	 */

	public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
		// TODO student implementation
		return new Move[0];
	}

	private boolean validateMove(Game game, Move move) {
		var rules = new Rule[] { new OutOfBoundaryRule(), new OccupiedRule(), new VacantRule(), new NilMoveRule(),
				new FirstNMovesProtectionRule(game.getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()), new KnightMoveRule(),
				new KnightBlockRule(), };
		for (var rule : rules) {
			if (!rule.validate(game, move)) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The `getAvailableMoves` method for the `Archer` piece should generate all possible moves according to the Archer's movement rules (similar to the cannon in Xiangqi). The Archer moves orthogonally (up, down, left, right) any number of squares, but it must jump exactly one piece (called the "screen") before it can capture an opponent piece or move to an empty square beyond that screen.

The method should:
- Explore all four directions from the source place.
- Find the first piece in that direction (the screen).
- After the screen, find valid target squares:
  - If the target square is empty, it can be moved to.
  - If the target square contains an opponent piece, it can be captured.
- Validate each move with the `validateMove` method before adding it to the result.

Here is a complete implementation of the `getAvailableMoves` method for the `Archer` class:

```java
@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    ArrayList<Move> moves = new ArrayList<>();
    int boardWidth = game.getConfiguration().getWidth();
    int boardHeight = game.getConfiguration().getHeight();

    // Directions: up, down, left, right
    int[][] directions = { {0, -1}, {0, 1}, {-1, 0}, {1, 0} };

    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        int dx = dir[0];
        int dy = dir[1];

        boolean screenFound = false;
        int x = source.getX();
        int y = source.getY();

        while (true) {
            x += dx;
            y += dy;

            // Check board boundaries
            if (x < 0 || x >= boardWidth || y < 0 || y >= boardHeight) {
                break;
            }

            Place target = Place.at(x, y);
            Piece targetPiece = game.getPieceAt(target);

            if (!screenFound) {
                // Looking for the screen piece to jump over
                if (targetPiece != null) {
                    screenFound = true;
                }
                // Can't move to any square before screen
                continue;
            } else {
                // After screen found, can move to empty or capture opponent piece
                if (targetPiece == null) {
                    Move move = new Move(source, target);
                    if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                        moves.add(move);
                    }
                } else {
                    // If piece belongs to opponent, can capture and stop in this direction
                    if (!targetPiece.getPlayer().equals(this.getPlayer())) {
                        Move move = new Move(source, target);
                        if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                            moves.add(move);
                        }
                    }
                    break; // Can't jump over second piece
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return moves.toArray(Move[]::new);
}
```

This implementation respects the Archer's movement rules and uses the existing `validateMove` method to ensure all moves are valid according to game rules.

/**

 *
 * @see <a href='https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xiangqi#Cannon'>Wikipedia</a>
 */

		//        throw new UnsupportedOperationException();

		return 'A';
	}

	 * All the returned {@link Move} should have source equal to the source parameter.
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: you should consider corner cases when the {@link Move} is not valid on the gameboard.

	 * <p>
	 * <strong>Attention: Student should make sure all {@link Move}s returned are valid.</strong>
	 *
	 * @param game   the game object
	 * @param source the current place of the piece
	 * @return an array of available moves
	 */
	@Override
	public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
		// TODO student implementation
		return new Move[0];
	}

	private boolean validateMove(Game game, Move move) {
		var rules = new Rule[] { new OutOfBoundaryRule(), new OccupiedRule(), new VacantRule(), new NilMoveRule(),
				new FirstNMovesProtectionRule(game.getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()), new ArcherMoveRule(), };
		for (var rule : rules) {
			if (!rule.validate(game, move)) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
}

- Use `source.getX()` and `source.getY()` for coordinates.

Here is the corrected method using these assumptions:

```java
@Override
public Move[] getAvailableMoves(Game game, Place source) {
    ArrayList<Move> moves = new ArrayList<>();
    int boardWidth = game.getConfiguration().getWidth();
    int boardHeight = game.getConfiguration().getHeight();

    // Directions: up, down, left, right
    int[][] directions = { {0, -1}, {0, 1}, {-1, 0}, {1, 0} };

    int startX = source.getX();
    int startY = source.getY();

    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        int dx = dir[0];
        int dy = dir[1];

        boolean screenFound = false;
        int x = startX;
        int y = startY;

        while (true) {
            x += dx;
            y += dy;

            // Check board boundaries
            if (x < 0 || x >= boardWidth || y < 0 || y >= boardHeight) {
                break;
            }

            Place target = Place.at(x, y);
            Piece targetPiece = game.getPieceAt(target);

            if (!screenFound) {
                // Looking for the screen piece to jump over
                if (targetPiece != null) {
                    screenFound = true;
                }
                // Can't move to any square before screen
                continue;
            } else {
                // After screen found, can move to empty or capture opponent piece
                if (targetPiece == null) {
                    Move move = new Move(source, target);
                    if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                        moves.add(move);
                    }
                } else {
                    // If piece belongs to opponent, can capture and stop in this direction
                    if (!targetPiece.getPlayer().equals(this.getPlayer())) {
                        Move move = new Move(source, target);
                        if (validateMove(game, move)) {
                            moves.add(move);
                        }
                    }
                    break; // Can't jump over second piece
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return moves.toArray(Move[]::new);
}

Response Text:---
The `validate` method should check if the move made by an Archer piece follows its specific moving rule, which is similar to the cannon in Xiangqi. Typically, the Archer moves like a rook (straight lines horizontally or vertically) but can only capture by jumping exactly one piece (the "screen") between the source and destination.

A correct implementation will:
- Check if the move is strictly horizontal or vertical.
- Count the number of pieces between source and destination.
- If the destination is empty, no pieces should be in between.
- If the destination has an opponent piece, exactly one piece should be in between.

Here is a complete implementation of the `validate` method for `ArcherMoveRule`:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Archer)) {
        return true;
    }

    int srcRow = move.getSource().row();
    int srcCol = move.getSource().col();
    int dstRow = move.getDestination().row();
    int dstCol = move.getDestination().col();

    // Archer moves only in straight lines
    if (srcRow != dstRow && srcCol != dstCol) {
        return false;
    }

    int countBetween = 0;

    if (srcRow == dstRow) {
        // Horizontal move
        int start = Math.min(srcCol, dstCol) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcCol, dstCol);
        for (int c = start; c < end; c++) {
            if (game.getPiece(new assignment.protocol.Position(srcRow, c)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Vertical move
        int start = Math.min(srcRow, dstRow) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcRow, dstRow);
        for (int r = start; r < end; r++) {
            if (game.getPiece(new assignment.protocol.Position(r, srcCol)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    }

    var destPiece = game.getPiece(move.getDestination());

    if (destPiece == null) {
        // Move without capture: no pieces in between allowed
        return countBetween == 0;
    } else {
        // Capture move: exactly one piece in between required
        // Also, cannot capture own piece
        var srcPiece = game.getPiece(move.getSource());
        if (srcPiece.getOwner().equals(destPiece.getOwner())) {
            return false;
        }
        return countBetween == 1;
    }
}
```

This method ensures the Archer moves according to the described rules and returns `true` if valid, `false` otherwise.

@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Archer)) {
        return true;
    }

    int srcRow = move.getSource().row();
    int srcCol = move.getSource().col();
    int dstRow = move.getDestination().row();
    int dstCol = move.getDestination().col();

    // Archer moves only in straight lines
    if (srcRow != dstRow && srcCol != dstCol) {
        return false;
    }

    int countBetween = 0;

    if (srcRow == dstRow) {
        // Horizontal move
        int start = Math.min(srcCol, dstCol) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcCol, dstCol);
        for (int c = start; c < end; c++) {

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Archer)) {
        return true;
    }

    int srcRow = move.getSource().getRow();
    int srcCol = move.getSource().getCol();
    int dstRow = move.getDestination().getRow();
    int dstCol = move.getDestination().getCol();

    // Archer moves only in straight lines
    if (srcRow != dstRow && srcCol != dstCol) {
        return false;
    }

    int countBetween = 0;

    if (srcRow == dstRow) {
        // Horizontal move
        int start = Math.min(srcCol, dstCol) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcCol, dstCol);
        for (int c = start; c < end; c++) {
            if (game.getPiece(new assignment.protocol.Place(srcRow, c)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Vertical move
        int start = Math.min(srcRow, dstRow) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcRow, dstRow);
        for (int r = start; r < end; r++) {
            if (game.getPiece(new assignment.protocol.Place(r, srcCol)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    }

    var destPiece = game.getPiece(move.getDestination());

    if (destPiece == null) {
        // Move without capture: no pieces in between allowed
        return countBetween == 0;
    } else {
        // Capture move: exactly one piece in between required
        // Also, cannot capture own piece
        var srcPiece = game.getPiece(move.getSource());
        if (srcPiece.owner().equals(destPiece.owner())) {
            return false;
        }
        return countBetween == 1;
    }
}

    int dstCol = move.getDestination().col;

    // Archer moves only in straight lines
    if (srcRow != dstRow && srcCol != dstCol) {
        return false;
    }

    int countBetween = 0;

    if (srcRow == dstRow) {
        // Horizontal move
        int start = Math.min(srcCol, dstCol) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcCol, dstCol);
        for (int c = start; c < end; c++) {
            if (game.getPiece(new assignment.protocol.Place(srcRow, c)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Vertical move
        int start = Math.min(srcRow, dstRow) + 1;
        int end = Math.max(srcRow, dstRow);
        for (int r = start; r < end; r++) {
            if (game.getPiece(new assignment.protocol.Place(r, srcCol)) != null) {
                countBetween++;
            }
        }
    }

    var destPiece = game.getPiece(move.getDestination());

    if (destPiece == null) {
        // Move without capture: no pieces in between allowed
        return countBetween == 0;
    } else {
        // Capture move: exactly one piece in between required
        // Also, cannot capture own piece
        var srcPiece = game.getPiece(move.getSource());
        if (srcPiece.owner().equals(destPiece.owner())) {
            return false;
        }
        return countBetween == 1;
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**  
- Access `row` and `col` as public fields directly (e.g., `move.getSource().row`).  
- Use `owner()` method (no `get`) to get the piece owner.  
- This matches the expected API and fixes the compilation errors.

The `validate` method should check if the move made by a Knight piece is valid according to chess rules. A Knight moves in an "L" shape: two squares in one direction (horizontal or vertical) and then one square perpendicular to that. The method should verify that the destination square is reachable by such a move from the source square.

Here is a complete implementation of the `validate` method for the `KnightMoveRule` class:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }

    int sourceRow = move.getSource().getRow();
    int sourceCol = move.getSource().getCol();
    int destRow = move.getDestination().getRow();
    int destCol = move.getDestination().getCol();

    int rowDiff = Math.abs(destRow - sourceRow);
    int colDiff = Math.abs(destCol - sourceCol);

    // Knight moves in an L shape: 2 by 1 or 1 by 2
    return (rowDiff == 2 && colDiff == 1) || (rowDiff == 1 && colDiff == 2);
}
```

This method returns `true` if the move is a valid Knight move, otherwise `false`.

Response Text:---
The method `validate` should check if the knight's move is blocked by another piece in the path, similar to the "horse leg" rule in Xiangqi. In Xiangqi, a knight moves one step orthogonally and then one step diagonally outward. The move is blocked if there is a piece immediately adjacent orthogonally in the direction of the first step.

To implement this, you need to:
1. Calculate the difference in rows and columns between the source and destination.
2. Identify the "blocking" square that must be empty for the knight to move.
3. Return false if that blocking square is occupied; otherwise, true.

Here is a complete implementation of the `validate` method:

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    if (!(game.getPiece(move.getSource()) instanceof Knight)) {
        return true;
    }

    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();

    int rowDiff = destination.getRow() - source.getRow();
    int colDiff = destination.getColumn() - source.getColumn();

    // Knight moves in an "L" shape: 2 by 1 or 1 by 2
    // Identify the blocking square based on the move direction
    Place blockingPlace;

    if (Math.abs(rowDiff) == 2 && Math.abs(colDiff) == 1) {
        // Vertical move first, blocking square is one step vertically from source
        blockingPlace = new Place(source.getRow() + rowDiff / 2, source.getColumn());
    } else if (Math.abs(rowDiff) == 1 && Math.abs(colDiff) == 2) {
        // Horizontal move first, blocking square is one step horizontally from source
        blockingPlace = new Place(source.getRow(), source.getColumn() + colDiff / 2);
    } else {
        // Not a valid knight move, but validation of move shape might be elsewhere
        return true;
    }

    // If the blocking place is occupied, the knight is blocked
    return game.getPiece(blockingPlace) == null;
}
```

This method returns `true` if the knight is not blocked and `false` if it is blocked.

```java
@Override
public boolean validate(Game game, Move move) {
    var destination = move.getDestination();
    var movingPlayer = game.getCurrentPlayer();
    var pieceAtDestination = game.getPieceAt(destination);
    return pieceAtDestination == null || !pieceAtDestination.getOwner().equals(movingPlayer);
}
```

- `move.getDestination()` gets the target position.
- `game.getCurrentPlayer()` gets the player who is making the move.
- `game.getPieceAt(destination)` returns the piece at the destination, or null if empty.
- The move is valid if the destination is empty or occupied by an opponent's piece (not the same owner).

The test failure indicates that the method `getAvailableMoves()` in the `Archer` class is returning incorrect results, causing the assertion expecting `true` to fail. This usually means the logic for generating valid moves is incomplete or incorrect.

To fix this, ensure the `getAvailableMoves()` method correctly calculates all valid moves for the Archer piece according to the game rules, including movement range, obstacles, and capturing rules.

Here is a corrected example of the `getAvailableMoves()` method for the `Archer` class that you can adapt. It assumes the Archer can move up to 2 spaces in any direction (orthogonal and diagonal), cannot move onto squares occupied by the same player, and can capture opponent pieces:

```java
@Override
public List<Move> getAvailableMoves(Game game) {
    List<Move> moves = new ArrayList<>();
    Place current = this.getPosition();
    Player owner = this.getPlayer();

    int[] directions = {-1, 0, 1};

    for (int dx : directions) {
        for (int dy : directions) {
            if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) continue; // skip no movement

            for (int step = 1; step <= 2; step++) {
                int newX = current.getX() + dx * step;
                int newY = current.getY() + dy * step;
                Place newPlace = new Place(newX, newY);

                if (!game.isValidPlace(newPlace)) break;

                var pieceAtDest = game.getPiece(newPlace);
                if (pieceAtDest == null) {
                    moves.add(new Move(current, newPlace));
                } else {
                    if (!pieceAtDest.getPlayer().equals(owner)) {
                        moves.add(new Move(current, newPlace)); // capture
                    }
                    break; // cannot jump over pieces
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return moves;
}
```

This method:

- Iterates over all directions (including diagonals).
- Checks up to 2 steps away.
- Adds moves to empty squares.
- Adds capturing moves if the piece belongs to the opponent.
- Stops checking further in a direction if blocked.

Adjust the movement range or rules if your game differs. This should fix the test failure by correctly providing all valid moves for the Archer.

@Override
public List<Move> getAvailableMoves(Game game) {
    List<Move> moves = new ArrayList<>();
    Place current = this.getPosition();
    Player owner = this.getPlayer();

    int[] directions = {-1, 0, 1};

    for (int dx : directions) {
        for (int dy : directions) {
            if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) continue; // skip no movement

            for (int step = 1; step <= 2; step++) {
                int newX = current.getX() + dx * step;
                int newY = current.getY() + dy * step;
                Place newPlace = new Place(newX, newY);

                if (!game.isValidPlace(newPlace)) break;

                var pieceAtDest = game.getPiece(newPlace);
                if (pieceAtDest == null) {
                    moves.add(new Move(current, newPlace));
                } else {
                    if (!pieceAtDest.getPlayer().equals(owner)) {
                        moves.add(new Move(current, newPlace)); // capture
                    }
                    break; // cannot jump over pieces
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return moves;
}

Response Text:---
The test failure likely means that some valid moves are missing from the returned list. The current code allows moves up to 2 steps in any direction, but it might be missing moves in straight lines beyond 2 steps or not handling directions correctly according to the Archer's movement rules.

If the Archer can move any number of steps in straight lines (like a rook or bishop), the code should iterate until blocked, not just up to 2 steps.

Here is a corrected method that moves in all 8 directions until blocked or out of bounds, adding valid moves and captures:

```java
@Override
public List<Move> getAvailableMoves(Game game) {
    List<Move> moves = new ArrayList<>();
    Place current = this.getPosition();
    Player owner = this.getPlayer();

    int[] directions = {-1, 0, 1};

    for (int dx : directions) {
        for (int dy : directions) {
            if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) continue; // skip no movement

            int step = 1;
            while (true) {
                int newX = current.getX() + dx * step;
                int newY = current.getY() + dy * step;
                Place newPlace = new Place(newX, newY);

                if (!game.isValidPlace(newPlace)) break;

                var pieceAtDest = game.getPiece(newPlace);
                if (pieceAtDest == null) {
                    moves.add(new Move(current, newPlace));
                } else {
                    if (!pieceAtDest.getPlayer().equals(owner)) {
                        moves.add(new Move(current, newPlace)); // capture
                    }
                    break; // cannot jump over pieces
                }
                step++;
            }
        }
    }
    return moves;
}
```

This version continues moving in each direction until blocked or out of bounds, which should satisfy the test expecting more complex available moves.

```java
@Override
public Move nextMove(Game game, Move[] availableMoves) {
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    while (true) {
        System.out.print("Enter your move (e.g. a1->b3): ");
        String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        Move move = parseMove(input);
        if (move == null) {
            System.out.println("Invalid input format. Please use the format 'a1->b3'.");
            continue;
        }

        // Check if the move is in availableMoves
        boolean found = false;
        for (Move m : availableMoves) {
            if (m.equals(move)) {
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!found) {
            System.out.println("Move not available. Please choose a valid move.");
            continue;
        }

        // Validate the move with rules
        String validationError = validateMove(game, move);
        if (validationError != null) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move: " + validationError);
            continue;
        }

        // Move is valid and available
        return move;
    }
}
```

This method ensures the user input is parsed and validated properly, and only a valid move from the available moves is returned.

/**
 * The player that makes move according to user input from console.
 */
public class ConsolePlayer extends Player {
	public ConsolePlayer(String name, Color color) {
		super(name, color);
	}

	public ConsolePlayer(String name) {
		this(name, Color.GREEN);
	}

	/**
	 * Choose a move from available moves.
	 * This method will be called by {@link Game} object to get the move that the player wants to make when it is the
	 * player's turn.
	 * <p>
	 * {@link ConsolePlayer} returns a move according to user's input in the console.
	 * The console input format should conform the format described in the assignment description.
	 * (e.g. {@literal a1->b3} means move the {@link Piece} at {@link Place}(x=0,y=0) to {@link Place}(x=1,y=2))
	 * Note that in the {@link Game}.board, the index starts from 0 in both x and y dimension, while in the console
	 * display, x dimension index starts from 'a' and y dimension index starts from 1.
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: be sure to handle invalid input to avoid invalid {@link Move}s.

	 * <strong>Attention: Student should make sure the {@link Move} returned is valid.</strong>
	 * <p>

	 * facilitate programming.
	 * This is VERY different from the coordinate used in console display.</strong>
	 *
	 * @param game           the current game object
	 * @param availableMoves available moves for this player to choose from.
	 * @return the chosen move

	@Override
	public Move nextMove(Game game, Move[] availableMoves) {
		// TODO student implementation
		return availableMoves[0];
	}

	private String validateMove(Game game, Move move) {
		var rules = new Rule[] { new OutOfBoundaryRule(), new OccupiedRule(), new VacantRule(), new NilMoveRule(),
				new FirstNMovesProtectionRule(game.getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()), new ArcherMoveRule(),
				new KnightMoveRule(), new KnightBlockRule(), };
		for (var rule : rules) {
			if (!rule.validate(game, move)) {
				return rule.getDescription();
			}

			var piece = game.getPiece(move.getSource());
			if (piece == null) {
				return "No piece at " + move.getSource().toString();
			}
			if (!this.equals(piece.getPlayer())) {
				return "Cannot move a piece not belonging to you";
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private static Place parsePlace(String str) {
		if (str.length() < 2) {
			return null;
		}
		try {
			var x = str.charAt(0) - 'a';
			var y = Integer.parseInt(str.substring(1)) - 1;
			return new Place(x, y);
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			return null;
		}
	}

	private static Move parseMove(String str) {
		var segments = str.split("->");
		if (segments.length < 2) {
			return null;
		}
		var source = parsePlace(segments[0].strip());
		if (source == null) {
			return null;
		}
		var destination = parsePlace(segments[1].strip());
		if (destination == null) {
			return null;
		}
		return new Move(source, destination);
	}
}

	 * Undoes a move by reverting all changes performed by the specified move.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Undoing a move is effectively the same as reversing everything you have done to make a move.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param prevMove The {@link MoveResult} object to revert.
	 */
	public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
		// TODO
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to move the player from a position in the specified direction as far as possible.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Note that this method does <b>NOT</b> actually move the player. It just tries to move the player and return
	 * the state of the player as-if it has been moved.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position of the player.
	 * @param direction The direction to move the player in.
	 * @return An instance of {@link MoveResult} representing the type of the move and the position of the player after
	 * moving.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private MoveResult tryMove(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var collectedGems = new ArrayList<Position>();
		final var collectedExtraLives = new ArrayList<Position>();
		Position lastValidPosition = position;
		do {
			final Position newPosition = offsetPosition(lastValidPosition, direction);
			if (newPosition == null) {
				break;
			}

			lastValidPosition = newPosition;

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof StopCell) {
				break;
			}

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof EntityCell entityCell) {
				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Mine) {
					return new MoveResult.Valid.Dead(position, newPosition);
				}

				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					collectedGems.add(newPosition);
				} else if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof ExtraLife) {
					collectedExtraLives.add(newPosition);
				}
			}
		} while (true);

		if (lastValidPosition.equals(position)) {
			return new MoveResult.Invalid(position);
		}

		return new MoveResult.Valid.Alive(lastValidPosition, position, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives);
	}

	/**
	 * Offsets the {@link Position} in the specified {@link Direction} by one step.
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position.
	 * @param direction The direction to offset.
	 * @return The given position offset by one in the specified direction. If the new position is outside of the game
	 * board, or contains a non-{@link EntityCell}, returns {@code null}.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position offsetPosition(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var newPos = position.offsetByOrNull(direction.getOffset(), gameBoard.getNumRows(),
				gameBoard.getNumCols());

		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (!(gameBoard.getCell(newPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The `makeMove` method should attempt to move the player in the given direction using the `tryMove` method. If the move is invalid or results in the player's death, the game board should not be changed and the method should return the corresponding `MoveResult`. If the move is valid and the player remains alive, the game board should be updated accordingly: move the player, remove collected gems and extra lives, and update the player's state (e.g., lives). The method returns the `MoveResult` describing the move outcome.

Here is a complete implementation of the `makeMove` method:

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

    // Get current player position
    final Position currentPosition = gameBoard.getPlayerPosition();
    if (currentPosition == null) {
        // No player on board, invalid move
        return new MoveResult.Invalid(null);
    }

    // Try to move the player
    final MoveResult moveResult = tryMove(currentPosition, direction);

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Invalid) {
        // Move invalid, do not mutate game board
        return moveResult;
    }

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        // Player dies after moving, do not mutate game board
        return deadMove;
    }

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        // Move is valid and player alive, update game board

        // Remove player from old position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getOldPosition(), new EmptyCell());

        // Place player at new position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getNewPosition(), new EntityCell(gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Remove collected gems and extra lives from the board
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.getCollectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EmptyCell());
        }
        for (Position lifePos : aliveMove.getCollectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(lifePos, new EmptyCell());
        }

        // Update player's lives if extra lives collected
        int extraLives = aliveMove.getCollectedExtraLives().size();
        if (extraLives > 0) {
            gameBoard.getPlayer().addLives(extraLives);
        }

        // Update player's position in the game board
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(aliveMove.getNewPosition());

        return aliveMove;
    }

    // Fallback: return invalid if none matched
    return new MoveResult.Invalid(currentPosition);
}
```

**Explanation:**

- The method first checks the current player position.
- It calls `tryMove` to simulate the move.
- If the move is invalid or results in death, it returns immediately without changing the board.
- If the move is valid and alive, it updates the board cells accordingly:
  - Removes the player from the old position.
  - Places the player in the new position.
  - Removes collected gems and extra lives from the board.
  - Adds extra lives to the player.
  - Updates the player's position in the game board.
- Returns the `MoveResult` describing the move.

This ensures the game board is only mutated if the move is valid and the player survives.

	 * </p>

	 * @return An instance of {@link MoveResult} representing the result of this action.

	public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction) {

	 * Undoes a move by reverting all changes performed by the specified move.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Undoing a move is effectively the same as reversing everything you have done to make a move.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param prevMove The {@link MoveResult} object to revert.
	 */
	public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
		// TODO
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to move the player from a position in the specified direction as far as possible.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Note that this method does <b>NOT</b> actually move the player. It just tries to move the player and return
	 * the state of the player as-if it has been moved.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position of the player.
	 * @param direction The direction to move the player in.
	 * @return An instance of {@link MoveResult} representing the type of the move and the position of the player after
	 * moving.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private MoveResult tryMove(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var collectedGems = new ArrayList<Position>();
		final var collectedExtraLives = new ArrayList<Position>();
		Position lastValidPosition = position;
		do {
			final Position newPosition = offsetPosition(lastValidPosition, direction);
			if (newPosition == null) {
				break;
			}

			lastValidPosition = newPosition;

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof StopCell) {
				break;
			}

			if (gameBoard.getCell(newPosition) instanceof EntityCell entityCell) {
				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Mine) {
					return new MoveResult.Valid.Dead(position, newPosition);
				}

				if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					collectedGems.add(newPosition);
				} else if (entityCell.getEntity() instanceof ExtraLife) {
					collectedExtraLives.add(newPosition);
				}
			}
		} while (true);

		if (lastValidPosition.equals(position)) {
			return new MoveResult.Invalid(position);
		}

		return new MoveResult.Valid.Alive(lastValidPosition, position, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives);
	}

	/**
	 * Offsets the {@link Position} in the specified {@link Direction} by one step.
	 *
	 * @param position  The original position.
	 * @param direction The direction to offset.
	 * @return The given position offset by one in the specified direction. If the new position is outside of the game
	 * board, or contains a non-{@link EntityCell}, returns {@code null}.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position offsetPosition(@NotNull final Position position, @NotNull final Direction direction) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(position);
		Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

		final var newPos = position.offsetByOrNull(direction.getOffset(), gameBoard.getNumRows(),
				gameBoard.getNumCols());

		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (!(gameBoard.getCell(newPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	public void GameBoardController(final GameBoard gameBoard) {
		this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard must not be null");
	}

- BOT: 
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(direction);

    // Get current player position
    final Position currentPosition = gameBoard.getPlayerPosition();
    if (currentPosition == null) {
        // No player on board, invalid move
        return new MoveResult.Invalid(null);
    }

    // Try to move the player
    final MoveResult moveResult = tryMove(currentPosition, direction);

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Invalid) {
        // Move invalid, do not mutate game board
        return moveResult;
    }

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        // Player dies after moving, do not mutate game board
        return deadMove;
    }

    if (moveResult instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        // Move is valid and player alive, update game board

        // Remove player from old position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getOldPosition(), new EmptyCell());

        // Place player at new position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getNewPosition(), new EntityCell(gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Remove collected gems and extra lives from the board
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.getCollectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EmptyCell());
        }
        for (Position lifePos : aliveMove.getCollectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(lifePos, new EmptyCell());
        }

        // Update player's lives if extra lives collected
        int extraLives = aliveMove.getCollectedExtraLives().size();
        if (extraLives > 0) {
            gameBoard.getPlayer().addLives(extraLives);
        }

        // Update player's position in the game board
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(aliveMove.getNewPosition());

        return aliveMove;
    }

    // Fallback: return invalid if none matched
    return new MoveResult.Invalid(currentPosition);

The `undoMove` method should reverse all changes made by the specified `MoveResult`. For a valid alive move, it means:

- Move the player back to the old position.
- Restore the player cell at the old position.
- Remove the player cell from the new position (replace with EmptyCell).
- Restore all collected gems and extra lives back to their original positions.
- Remove the extra lives added to the player.

For a dead move, presumably the player died stepping on a mine, so undoing it means restoring the player at the old position and removing the dead state.

For invalid moves, no changes were made, so nothing to undo.

Here is a complete implementation of the `undoMove` method:

```java
public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(prevMove, "prevMove must not be null");

    if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        // Move player back to old position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getNewPosition(), new EmptyCell());
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getOldPosition(), new EntityCell(gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Restore collected gems
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.getCollectedGems()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new EntityCell(new Gem()));
        }

        // Restore collected extra lives
        for (Position lifePos : aliveMove.getCollectedExtraLives()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(lifePos, new EntityCell(new ExtraLife()));
        }

        // Remove extra lives added to player
        int extraLives = aliveMove.getCollectedExtraLives().size();
        if (extraLives > 0) {
            gameBoard.getPlayer().removeLives(extraLives);
        }

        // Reset player position
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(aliveMove.getOldPosition());

    } else if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {
        // Player died moving from oldPosition to newPosition
        // Undo by restoring player at old position and empty cell at new position
        gameBoard.setCell(deadMove.getNewPosition(), new EmptyCell());
        gameBoard.setCell(deadMove.getOldPosition(), new EntityCell(gameBoard.getPlayer()));
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(deadMove.getOldPosition());

    } else if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Invalid) {
        // No changes were made, nothing to undo
    }
}

public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(prevMove, "prevMove must not be null");

    if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Alive aliveMove) {
        // Move player back to old position
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getNewPosition(), new pa1.model.EmptyCell());
        gameBoard.setCell(aliveMove.getOldPosition(), new pa1.model.EntityCell(gameBoard.getPlayer()));

        // Restore collected gems
        for (Position gemPos : aliveMove.getCollectedGemsPositions()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(gemPos, new pa1.model.EntityCell(new pa1.model.Gem()));
        }

        // Restore collected extra lives
        for (Position lifePos : aliveMove.getCollectedExtraLivesPositions()) {
            gameBoard.setCell(lifePos, new pa1.model.EntityCell(new pa1.model.ExtraLife()));
        }

        // Reset player position
        gameBoard.setPlayerPosition(aliveMove.getOldPosition());

    } else if (prevMove instanceof MoveResult.Valid.Dead deadMove) {

}

```java
public GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
    if (cells == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
    }
    if (numRows != cells.length) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
    }
    if (numRows > 0 && (cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
    }

    this.numRows = numRows;
    this.numCols = numCols;

    // Defensive copy of the board
    this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
    for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
        if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
        }
        System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
    }

    // Find the single player
    this.player = getSinglePlayer();

    // Check that there is at least one gem
    int gemCount = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
            Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
            if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
                gemCount++;
            }
        }
    }
    if (gemCount == 0) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
    }

    // Check that all gems are reachable from the player's position
    if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not all gems are reachable from the player");
    }
}
```

This constructor uses the existing private methods `getSinglePlayer()` and `isAllGemsReachable()` to perform the required validations. It also copies the input cells array to the internal `board` field to avoid external mutation.

 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).

public final class GameBoard {

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * The main game board of the game.
 *
 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>
 */
public final class GameBoard {

	/**
	 * Number of rows in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numRows;
	/**
	 * Number of columns in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numCols;

	/**
	 * 2D array representing each cell in the game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Cell[][] board;

	/**
	 * The instance of {@link Player} on this game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Player player;

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether all gems are reachable from the player's initial position.
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if all gems are reachable.
	 */
	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {
		final var expectedNumOfGems = getNumGems();

		final var initialPosition = Objects.requireNonNull(getPlayer().getOwner()).getPosition();
		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

		int actualNumOfGems = 0;
		for (final var pos : playerReachableCells) {
			final var cell = getCell(pos);
			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numRows > 0 && (cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not all gems are reachable from the player");
		}
	}

						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>

	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull

				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**

	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.

	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {

		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;

	}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numRows > 0 && (cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not all gems are reachable from the player");
		}
	}

	public Cell[] getRow(final int row) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		return board[row].clone();
	}
}

import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

 * The main game board of the game.

 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>

public final class GameBoard {

	/**
	 * Number of rows in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numRows;
	/**
	 * Number of columns in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numCols;

	/**

	 */

	@NotNull

	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**

	@NotNull

		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {

					if (posToAdd == null) {

					}
				}
			}
		}

	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

			}
		}

	}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numRows > 0 && (cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not all gems are reachable from the player");
		}
	}

	public Cell[] getRow(final int row) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		return board[row].clone();
	}

	public Cell[] getCol(final int col) {
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		Cell[] column = new Cell[numRows];
		for (int row = 0; row < numRows; row++) {
			column[row] = board[row][col];
		}
		return column;
	}

	public Cell getCell(final int row, final int col) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		return board[row][col];
	}
}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * The main game board of the game.
 *
 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>
 */
public final class GameBoard {

	/**
	 * Number of rows in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numRows;
	/**
	 * Number of columns in the game board.
	 */
	private final int numCols;

	/**
	 * 2D array representing each cell in the game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Cell[][] board;

	/**
	 * The instance of {@link Player} on this game board.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final Player player;

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllStoppablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> posToTraverse = new ArrayList<>();

		posToTraverse.add(initialPosition);

		while (!posToTraverse.isEmpty()) {
			final var nextPos = posToTraverse.remove(posToTraverse.size() - 1);

			if (!(getCell(nextPos) instanceof EntityCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (allStoppablePos.contains(nextPos)) {
				continue;
			}
			allStoppablePos.add(nextPos);

			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffset);

					if (posToAdd == null) {
						final var maxDist = i - 1;
						if (maxDist > 0) {
							final var posOffsetBeforeThis = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * maxDist,
									dir.getColOffset() * maxDist);
							final var posBeforeThis = getEntityCellByOffset(nextPos, posOffsetBeforeThis);

							if (posBeforeThis != null && !posToTraverse.contains(posBeforeThis)) {
								posToTraverse.add(posBeforeThis);
							}
						}

						break;
					}

					if (getCell(posToAdd) instanceof StopCell || isBorderCell(posToAdd, dir)) {
						posToTraverse.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allStoppablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which are reachable from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is reachable iff the player can move over the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all reachable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions reachable from {@code initialPosition}.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private List<Position> getAllReachablePositions(@NotNull final Position initialPosition) {
		Objects.requireNonNull(initialPosition);

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether all gems are reachable from the player's initial position.
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if all gems are reachable.
	 */
	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {
		final var expectedNumOfGems = getNumGems();

		final var initialPosition = Objects.requireNonNull(getPlayer().getOwner()).getPosition();
		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

		int actualNumOfGems = 0;
		for (final var pos : playerReachableCells) {
			final var cell = getCell(pos);
			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}

		final List<Position> allReachablePos = new ArrayList<>();
		final List<Position> allStoppablePos = getAllStoppablePositions(initialPosition);

		for (@NotNull
		final var reachablePos : allStoppablePos) {
			for (@NotNull
			final var dir : Direction.values()) {
				for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(getNumRows(), getNumCols()); ++i) {
					final var posOffset = new PositionOffset(dir.getRowOffset() * i, dir.getColOffset() * i);
					final var posToAdd = getEntityCellByOffset(reachablePos, posOffset);
					if (posToAdd == null) {
						break;
					}

					if (!allReachablePos.contains(posToAdd)) {
						allReachablePos.add(posToAdd);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		return Collections.unmodifiableList(allReachablePos);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the given cell is a border cell with reference to the direction.
	 *
	 * @param cellPos The position of the cell.
	 * @param dir     The direction is moving at.
	 * @return {@code true} if the cell at the specified position is a border cell, i.e. the last cell in the game board
	 * before going out of bounds in the given direction.
	 */
	private boolean isBorderCell(@NotNull final Position cellPos, @NotNull final Direction dir) {
		return switch (dir) {
		case UP -> cellPos.row() == 0;
		case DOWN -> cellPos.row() == getNumRows() - 1;
		case LEFT -> cellPos.col() == 0;
		case RIGHT -> cellPos.col() == getNumCols() - 1;
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether all gems are reachable from the player's initial position.
	 *
	 * @return {@code true} if all gems are reachable.
	 */
	private boolean isAllGemsReachable() {
		final var expectedNumOfGems = getNumGems();

		final var initialPosition = Objects.requireNonNull(getPlayer().getOwner()).getPosition();
		final var playerReachableCells = getAllReachablePositions(initialPosition);

		int actualNumOfGems = 0;
		for (final var pos : playerReachableCells) {
			final var cell = getCell(pos);
			if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
				++actualNumOfGems;
			}
		}

		return expectedNumOfGems == actualNumOfGems;
	}

	public void GameBoard(final int numRows, final int numCols, final Cell[][] cells) {
		if (cells == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array cannot be null");
		}
		if (numRows != cells.length) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numRows does not match cells.length");
		}
		if (numRows > 0 && (cells[0] == null || numCols != cells[0].length)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("numCols does not match cells[0].length");
		}
		this.numRows = numRows;
		this.numCols = numCols;
		this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			if (cells[r] == null || cells[r].length != numCols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All rows must have length equal to numCols");
			}
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
		}
		this.player = getSinglePlayer();
		int gemCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < numCols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.board[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Gem) {
					gemCount++;
				}
			}
		}
		if (gemCount == 0) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("There must be at least one gem on the board");
		}
		if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not all gems are reachable from the player");
		}
	}

	public Cell[] getRow(final int row) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		return board[row].clone();
	}

	public Cell[] getCol(final int col) {
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);
		}
		Cell[] column = new Cell[numRows];
		for (int row = 0; row < numRows; row++) {
			column[row] = board[row][col];
		}
		return column;
	}

	public Cell getCell(final int row, final int col) {
		if (row < 0 || row >= numRows) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Row index out of bounds: " + row);
		}
		if (col < 0 || col >= numCols) {
			throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("Column index out of bounds: " + col);

	/**
	 * Checks that a single player exists on the game board, and returns the instance of the player.
	 *
	 * @return The single instance of player on the game board.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the game board has zero, or more than one player entities.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private Player getSinglePlayer() {
		Player player = null;
		for (final var row : board) {
			for (final var cell : row) {
				if (cell instanceof EntityCell ec && ec.getEntity() instanceof Player p) {
					if (player != null) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException();
					}

					player = p;
				}
			}
		}

		if (player == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException();
		}

		return player;

	 * Retrieves the instance of {@link EntityCell} by a position with an offset.
	 *
	 * @param pos    Position.
	 * @param offset Positional offset to apply.
	 * @return An instance of {@link EntityCell}, or {@code null} if the resulting position does not contain an entity
	 * cell.
	 */
	@Nullable
	private Position getEntityCellByOffset(@NotNull final Position pos, @NotNull final PositionOffset offset) {
		final var newPos = pos.offsetByOrNull(offset, getNumRows(), getNumCols());
		if (newPos == null) {
			return null;
		}
		if (getCell(newPos) instanceof Wall) {
			return null;
		}

		return newPos;

	/**
	 * Gets all {@link Position} of cells which the player can stop on from the cell of the {@code initialPosition}.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * A cell is "stoppable" iff the player can stop on the cell with any combination of valid moves.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param initialPosition The starting position to get all stoppable cells.
	 * @return {@link List} of all positions stoppable from {@code initialPosition}.
