	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isBlank()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 (unlimited) or non-negative");
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> players = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Position>> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, line.length());
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (players.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player '" + c + "' found");
					}
					players.put(c, pos);
					entity = new Player(c - 'A');
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					boxes.computeIfAbsent(c, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(pos);
					entity = new Box(c - 'a');
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException(
							"Invalid character '" + c + "' at position (" + x + "," + y + ")");
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
			for (int x = line.length(); x < maxWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				map.put(pos, new Empty());
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		int totalBoxes = boxes.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum();
		if (totalBoxes != destinations.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + totalBoxes
					+ ") does not equal number of destinations (" + destinations.size() + ")");
		}
		Set<Integer> playerIds = players.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'A').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		Set<Integer> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'a').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (int pid : boxPlayerIds) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + pid + " has no corresponding player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (int pid : playerIds) {
			if (!boxPlayerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player with id " + pid + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}
}

		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);

		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isBlank()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 (unlimited) or non-negative");
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> players = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Position>> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, line.length());
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (players.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player '" + c + "' found");
					}
					players.put(c, pos);
					entity = new Player(c - 'A');
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					boxes.computeIfAbsent(c, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(pos);
					entity = new Box(c - 'a');
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException(
							"Invalid character '" + c + "' at position (" + x + "," + y + ")");
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
			for (int x = line.length(); x < maxWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				map.put(pos, new Empty());
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		int totalBoxes = boxes.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum();
		if (totalBoxes != destinations.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + totalBoxes
					+ ") does not equal number of destinations (" + destinations.size() + ")");
		}
		Set<Integer> playerIds = players.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'A').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		Set<Integer> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'a').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (int pid : boxPlayerIds) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + pid + " has no corresponding player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (int pid : playerIds) {
			if (!boxPlayerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player with id " + pid + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());

	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;

	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.

	public int getMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isBlank()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 (unlimited) or non-negative");
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> players = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Position>> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, line.length());
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (players.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player '" + c + "' found");
					}
					players.put(c, pos);
					entity = new Player(c - 'A');
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					boxes.computeIfAbsent(c, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(pos);
					entity = new Box(c - 'a');
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException(
							"Invalid character '" + c + "' at position (" + x + "," + y + ")");
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
			for (int x = line.length(); x < maxWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				map.put(pos, new Empty());
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		int totalBoxes = boxes.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum();
		if (totalBoxes != destinations.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + totalBoxes
					+ ") does not equal number of destinations (" + destinations.size() + ")");
		}
		Set<Integer> playerIds = players.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'A').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		Set<Integer> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'a').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (int pid : boxPlayerIds) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + pid + " has no corresponding player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (int pid : playerIds) {
			if (!boxPlayerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player with id " + pid + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		if (position == null || entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Position and entity must not be null");
		}
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the undo limit of the game map.
	 * @return  undo limit as Optional. If undoLimit is -1 (unlimited), returns Optional.empty(). Otherwise, returns Optional.of(undoLimit).
	 */
	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return undoLimit == -1 ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all players' id as a set.
	 * @return  a set of player id.
	 */
	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}

		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = new HashMap<>(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isBlank()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 (unlimited) or non-negative");
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> players = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Position>> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, line.length());
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (players.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player '" + c + "' found");
					}
					players.put(c, pos);
					entity = new Player(c - 'A');
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					boxes.computeIfAbsent(c, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(pos);
					entity = new Box(c - 'a');
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException(
							"Invalid character '" + c + "' at position (" + x + "," + y + ")");
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
			for (int x = line.length(); x < maxWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				map.put(pos, new Empty());
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		int totalBoxes = boxes.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum();
		if (totalBoxes != destinations.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + totalBoxes
					+ ") does not equal number of destinations (" + destinations.size() + ")");
		}
		Set<Integer> playerIds = players.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'A').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		Set<Integer> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'a').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (int pid : boxPlayerIds) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + pid + " has no corresponding player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (int pid : playerIds) {
			if (!boxPlayerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player with id " + pid + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		if (position == null || entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Position and entity must not be null");
		}
		map.put(position, entity);
		// Update maxWidth and maxHeight if needed
		if (position.x() + 1 > maxWidth) {
			maxWidth = position.x() + 1;
		}
		if (position.y() + 1 > maxHeight) {
			maxHeight = position.y() + 1;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the undo limit of the game map.
	 * @return  undo limit as Optional. If undoLimit is -1 (unlimited), returns Optional.empty(). Otherwise, returns Optional.of(undoLimit).
	 */
	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return undoLimit == -1 ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get all players' id as a set.
	 * @return  a set of player id.
	 */
	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}

					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
					if (players.containsKey(c)) {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player '" + c + "' found");
					}
					players.put(c, pos);
					entity = new Player(c - 'A');
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					boxes.computeIfAbsent(c, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(pos);
					entity = new Box(c - 'a');
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException(
							"Invalid character '" + c + "' at position (" + x + "," + y + ")");
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
			for (int x = line.length(); x < maxWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				map.put(pos, new Empty());
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		int totalBoxes = boxes.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum();
		if (totalBoxes != destinations.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + totalBoxes
					+ ") does not equal number of destinations (" + destinations.size() + ")");
		}
		Set<Integer> playerIds = players.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'A').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		Set<Integer> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'a').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (int pid : boxPlayerIds) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + pid + " has no corresponding player on the board");
			}
		}
		for (int pid : playerIds) {
			if (!boxPlayerIds.contains(pid)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player with id " + pid + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity object at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity in the game map.
	 * @return  Entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		if (position == null || entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Position and entity must not be null");
		}
		map.put(position, entity);
		// Update maxWidth and maxHeight if needed
		if (position.x() + 1 > maxWidth) {

		}
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map.

Response Text:---
The error is likely caused by the `map` field being declared as `final` but reassigned in the private constructor and modified in `putEntity`. Also, the `map` field is wrapped as unmodifiable in the private constructor but not in the public one, causing inconsistent behavior. To fix this, `map` should be a mutable `HashMap` consistently, and `putEntity` should update the map correctly without violating immutability. Also, remove the unmodifiable wrapper from the private constructor to allow modifications.

Here is the corrected `GameMap` class with these fixes applied:

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private int maxWidth;

	private int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = new HashMap<>(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isBlank()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.split("\\R");
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be an integer");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1 || (undoLimit < 0 && undoLimit != -1)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit must be -1 (unlimited) or non-negative");
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> map = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Character, Position> players = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, List<Position>> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int maxWidth = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, line.length());
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char c = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity;
				if (c == '#') {
					entity = new Wall();
				} else if (c == '@') {
					entity = new Empty();
					destinations.add(pos);
				} else if (c == '.') {
					entity = new Empty();
				} else if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {

						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player '" + c + "' found");
					}

					entity = new Player(c - 'A');
				} else if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) {
					boxes.computeIfAbsent(c, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(pos);
					entity = new Box(c - 'a');
				} else {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException(
							"Invalid character '" + c + "' at position (" + x + "," + y + ")");
				}
				map.put(pos, entity);
			}
			for (int x = line.length(); x < maxWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				map.put(pos, new Empty());
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		int totalBoxes = boxes.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum();
		if (totalBoxes != destinations.size()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + totalBoxes
					+ ") does not equal number of destinations (" + destinations.size() + ")");
		}
		Set<Integer> playerIds = players.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'A').collect(Collectors.toSet());
		Set<Integer> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(c -> c - 'a').collect(Collectors.toSet());

				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player with id " + pid + " has no corresponding boxes");
			}
		}
		return new GameMap(map, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

**Explanation:**  
- The `map` field is now always a mutable `HashMap` (no unmodifiable wrapper).  
- The private constructor copies the map to a new `HashMap` to avoid external mutation but keeps it mutable internally.  
- `putEntity` modifies the map directly and updates `maxWidth` and `maxHeight` accordingly.  
- This prevents `UnsupportedOperationException` or `NullPointerException` caused by unmodifiable collections or inconsistent state.

			maxWidth = position.x() + 1;
		}
		if (position.y() + 1 > maxHeight) {
			maxHeight = position.y() + 1;
		}
	}

			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}

The method `getPlayerPositionById` should find the position of the player entity with the given id from the `entities` map. Since `entities` maps positions to entities, you need to iterate over the entries, check if the entity is a `Player` and if its id matches the given id, then return the corresponding position.

Here is a complete implementation of the method:

```java
public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
        Entity entity = entry.getValue();
        if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
            return entry.getKey();
        }
    }
    return null; // or throw an exception if player not found
}
```

This method returns the position of the player with the specified id, or `null` if no such player exists. Adjust the return behavior if you want to handle the "not found" case differently.

			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota();
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

Response Text:---
The `isWin` method should check if every destination position in the game is currently occupied by a box. Since `destinations` is a set of positions that must be occupied by boxes, and `entities` maps positions to entities, you can iterate over all destinations and verify that the entity at each destination is an instance of `Box`.

Here is a complete implementation of the `isWin` method:

```java
/**
 * Check whether the game wins or not.
 * The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
 *
 * @return true if the game wins.
 */
public boolean isWin() {
    for (Position destination : destinations) {
        Entity entity = entities.get(destination);
        if (!(entity instanceof Box)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);

			this.moves = moves;

			this.moves = new HashMap<>();

			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));

					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

This means pushing a snapshot of the current transition (moves made since last checkpoint) and the current undo quota onto the history stack, then resetting the current transition to start fresh for the next moves.

```java

    // Create a new Transition object copying current moves
    Transition snapshot = new Transition(new HashMap<>(currentTransition.moves));
    // Push a new Transition onto history stack representing this checkpoint
    history.push(snapshot);
    // Reset currentTransition for next moves
    currentTransition = new Transition();
}
```

- We create a copy of the currentTransition's moves map to avoid mutation issues.
- Push this snapshot onto the history stack.
- Reset currentTransition to empty for recording future moves after this checkpoint.

This allows the undo method to revert to the last checkpoint by popping from history.

public void undo() {
    if (undoQuota <= 0) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
    }

    Transition transitionToUndo;
    if (!history.isEmpty()) {

		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota();
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota < 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true if the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		for (Position destination : destinations) {
			Entity entity = entities.get(destination);
			if (!(entity instanceof Box)) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null || entity instanceof Empty) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity to move at position: " + from);
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> newEntities = new HashMap<>(entities);
		newEntities.put(to, entity);
		newEntities.put(from, new Empty());
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		((HashMap<Position, Entity>) this.entities).put(to, entity);
		((HashMap<Position, Entity>) this.entities).put(from, new Empty());
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		Transition snapshot = new Transition(new HashMap<>(currentTransition.moves));
		history.push(snapshot);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		undoQuota--;
		Transition transitionToUndo;
		if (!history.isEmpty()) {
			transitionToUndo = history.pop();
		} else {
			transitionToUndo = currentTransition;
			currentTransition = new Transition();
		}
		Transition reverseTransition = transitionToUndo.reverse();
		applyTransition(reverseTransition);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota();
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota < 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true if the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		for (Position destination : destinations) {
			Entity entity = entities.get(destination);
			if (!(entity instanceof Box)) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null || entity instanceof Empty) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity to move at position: " + from);
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> newEntities = new HashMap<>(entities);
		newEntities.put(to, entity);
		newEntities.put(from, new Empty());
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		((HashMap<Position, Entity>) this.entities).put(to, entity);
		((HashMap<Position, Entity>) this.entities).put(from, new Empty());
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		Transition snapshot = new Transition(new HashMap<>(currentTransition.moves));
		history.push(snapshot);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		undoQuota--;
		Transition transitionToUndo;
		if (!history.isEmpty()) {
			transitionToUndo = history.pop();
		} else {
			transitionToUndo = currentTransition;
			currentTransition = new Transition();
		}
		Transition reverseTransition = transitionToUndo.reverse();
		applyTransition(reverseTransition);
	}

	 * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */

		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The error "The constructor GameState(GameMap) is undefined" indicates that your `GameState` class currently does not have a proper constructor but instead has a method named `GameState` with a return type `void` missing (or mistakenly declared as a method). In Java, constructors must not have a return type.

You have this code snippet in your class:

```java
public void GameState(GameMap map) {
    ...
}
```

This is a method, not a constructor. You need to remove the `void` return type so that it becomes a proper constructor.

---

**Corrected constructor code:**

```java
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
    this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota();
    Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
            tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }
    this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
    this.history.clear();
    this.currentTransition = new Transition();
}
```

---

**Explanation:**  
- Remove `void` from `public void GameState(GameMap map)` to make it a constructor.  
- Constructors have no return type, not even `void`.  
- This change will fix the compilation error and allow the tests and code to instantiate `GameState` with a `GameMap` parameter correctly.

---

**Final corrected constructor method:**

```java
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));

}

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
		this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota();
		Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
				tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player player && player.getId() == id) {
				return entry.getKey();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Get current positions of all players in the game map.
	 * @return  a set of positions of all players.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	/**
	 * Get the entity that is currently at the given position.
	 * @param position  the position of the entity.
	 * @return  the entity object.
	 */
	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, new Empty());
	}

	/**
	 * Get all box destination positions as a set in the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  a set of positions.
	 */
	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		if (undoQuota < 0) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoQuota);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check whether the game wins or not. The game wins only when all box destinations have been occupied by boxes.
	 * @return  true if the game wins.
	 */
	public boolean isWin() {
		for (Position destination : destinations) {
			Entity entity = entities.get(destination);
			if (!(entity instanceof Box)) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null || entity instanceof Empty) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity to move at position: " + from);
		}
		Map<Position, Entity> newEntities = new HashMap<>(entities);
		newEntities.put(to, entity);
		newEntities.put(from, new Empty());
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		((HashMap<Position, Entity>) this.entities).put(to, entity);
		((HashMap<Position, Entity>) this.entities).put(from, new Empty());
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		Transition snapshot = new Transition(new HashMap<>(currentTransition.moves));
		history.push(snapshot);
		currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left.");
		}
		undoQuota--;
		Transition transitionToUndo;
		if (!history.isEmpty()) {
			transitionToUndo = history.pop();
		} else {
			transitionToUndo = currentTransition;
			currentTransition = new Transition();
		}
		Transition reverseTransition = transitionToUndo.reverse();
		applyTransition(reverseTransition);
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map. This should be the same as that in  {@link GameMap}  class.
	 * @return  maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The error occurs because the method named `GameState(GameMap map)` is not a constructor but a regular method (it has a void return type implicitly due to the `void` keyword missing but the syntax is wrong). In Java, constructors must not have a return type and must have the exact same name as the class.

To fix the issue, you need to convert that method into a proper constructor by removing the `void` keyword (or any return type) and making sure it has no return type at all.

Here is the corrected `GameState` constructor:

```java
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    this.boardWidth = map.getMaxWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getMaxHeight();
    this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations()));
    this.undoQuota = map.getUndoQuota();
    Map<Position, Entity> tempEntities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntity(pos);
            tempEntities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }
    this.entities = Collections.unmodifiableMap(tempEntities);
    this.history.clear();
    this.currentTransition = new Transition();
}
```

**Explanation:**  
- Remove the `void` keyword or any return type before `GameState(GameMap map)` so that it becomes a constructor.  
- Constructors have no return type and share the class name exactly.  
- This will fix the "constructor undefined" compilation error and allow the tests to instantiate `GameState` properly.

import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import assignment.utils.ShouldNotReachException;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import static assignment.utils.StringResources.PLAYER_NOT_FOUND;
import static assignment.utils.StringResources.UNDO_QUOTA_RUN_OUT;

/**
 * A base implementation of Sokoban Game.
 */
public abstract class AbstractSokobanGame implements SokobanGame {
	@NotNull
	protected final GameState state;

	private boolean isExitSpecified = false;

	protected AbstractSokobanGame(@NotNull GameState gameState) {
		this.state = gameState;
	}

	/**
	 * @return True is the game should stop running.
	 * For example when the user specified to exit the game or the user won the game.
	 */
	protected boolean shouldStop() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * @param action The action received from the user.
	 * @return The result of the action.
	 */
	protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * @param playerPosition The position of the player.
	 * @param move           One-step move. We assume every move has only one step.
	 * @return The action result for the move.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private ActionResult processOneStepMove(@NotNull Position playerPosition, @NotNull Move move) {
		final Position nextPlayerPos = move.nextPosition(playerPosition);
		final Entity nextEntity = this.state.getEntity(nextPlayerPos);

		if (nextEntity instanceof Empty) {
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos); // move if next place is empty
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Wall) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit a wall.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Player) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit another player.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Box box) {
			if (box.getPlayerId() != move.getInitiator()) {
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You cannot move other players' boxes.");
			}
			final Position nextBoxPos = move.nextPosition(nextPlayerPos);
			if (!(this.state.getEntity(nextBoxPos) instanceof Empty))
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "Failed to push the box.");
			this.state.move(nextPlayerPos, nextBoxPos);
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos);
			// Game history checkpoint reached if any box is moved.
			this.state.checkpoint();
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}
		throw new ShouldNotReachException();
	}
}

The `processAction` method should handle different types of `Action` objects (`Move`, `Undo`, `Exit`, and others). It should delegate the processing accordingly:

- For `Move`, find the player position and call `processOneStepMove`.
- For `Undo`, check if undo quota is available, then undo the last move.
- For `Exit`, mark the game to stop.
- For unknown or invalid actions, return an `ActionResult.Failed` or `InvalidInput`.

Here is a complete implementation of the `processAction` method:

```java
/**
 * @param action The action received from the user.
 * @return The result of the action.
 */
protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
    if (action instanceof Move move) {
        // Find the player position for the initiator of the move
        Position playerPosition = state.findPlayerPosition(move.getInitiator());
        if (playerPosition == null) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(move, PLAYER_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        return processOneStepMove(playerPosition, move);
    }

    if (action instanceof Undo undo) {
        if (state.getUndoQuota() <= 0) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(undo, UNDO_QUOTA_RUN_OUT);
        }
        boolean undone = state.undo();
        if (undone) {
            return new ActionResult.Success(undo);
        } else {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(undo, "Nothing to undo.");
        }
    }

    if (action instanceof Exit exit) {
        isExitSpecified = true;
        return new ActionResult.Success(exit);
    }

    // For any other unknown or invalid action
    return new ActionResult.Failed(action, "Invalid action.");
}

The `run` method should implement the main game loop for the terminal Sokoban game. It needs to repeatedly render the game state, get input from the user, perform the corresponding action, and update the game state until the game ends or the player quits.

Here is a complete implementation of the `run` method for `TerminalSokobanGame`:

```java
@Override
public void run() {
    renderingEngine.render(gameState);
    boolean running = true;
    while (running) {
        Action action = inputEngine.getNextAction();
        if (action == null) {
            // No action received, continue or break as needed
            continue;
        }
        ActionResult result = gameState.performAction(action);
        renderingEngine.render(gameState);
        if (result.isGameOver()) {
            renderingEngine.showMessage("Game over! Thanks for playing.");
            running = false;
        } else if (result.isQuit()) {
            renderingEngine.showMessage("Game quit.");
            running = false;
        } else if (!result.isSuccess()) {
            renderingEngine.showMessage("Invalid move, try again.");
        }
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Initially renders the current game state.
- Enters a loop where it:
  - Gets the next action from the input engine.
  - Performs the action on the game state.
  - Renders the updated game state.
  - Checks if the game is over or the player quit, then stops the loop.
  - If the action was invalid, shows a message and continues.

This approach assumes that `ActionResult` has methods like `isGameOver()`, `isQuit()`, and `isSuccess()`, and that `RenderingEngine` has a method `showMessage(String)` to display messages to the user. Adjust method names if your actual API differs.

package assignment.tui;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {
		// TODO
		// Hint: System.out is also a PrintStream.

The method `fetchAction` should read a line from the terminal, parse it, and return the corresponding `Action` object. According to the imports and constants, it should recognize commands for exit, undo, move, and invalid input. The `MOVE_REGEX` pattern matches single-character move commands (WASD, R, HJKL, U, case-insensitive). If the input matches exit command text, return an `Exit` action; if it matches undo command, return `Undo`; if it matches move pattern, return a `Move` action with the parsed direction; otherwise, return `InvalidInput`.

Here is a complete implementation of the `fetchAction` method:

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit();
    }

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U")) {
        return new Undo();
    }

    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        char actionChar = matcher.group("action").toUpperCase().charAt(0);
        // Assuming Move constructor accepts a char representing direction
        return new Move(actionChar);
    }

    return new InvalidInput(INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
}
```

This method reads the input, checks for exit, undo, move commands, and returns an appropriate `Action`. If none matches, it returns an `InvalidInput` with a message.

Here is a corrected method implementing `nextPosition` properly:

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit(0);
    }

    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U")) {
        return new Undo(0);
    }

    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        char actionChar = matcher.group("action").toUpperCase().charAt(0);
        return new Move(0) {
            @Override
            public assignment.game.Position nextPosition(assignment.game.Position currentPosition) {
                int x = currentPosition.x();
                int y = currentPosition.y();
                return switch (actionChar) {
                    case 'W', 'K', 'U' -> new assignment.game.Position(x, y - 1); // Up
                    case 'A', 'H', 'L' -> new assignment.game.Position(x - 1, y); // Left
                    case 'S', 'J', 'R' -> new assignment.game.Position(x, y + 1); // Down
                    case 'D' -> new assignment.game.Position(x + 1, y); // Right
                    default -> currentPosition;
                };
            }
        };
    }

    return new InvalidInput(0, INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE);
}
